purpose: Machine-readable three-member C3 framed control family requested by the Meridian reply in issue #4. This is a deliberately declared benchmark fixture, not a recovered historical SAT/H(s)H geometry and not a physical claim.

source_boundary.fixture_semantics: synthetic control geometry for interface discrimination
not_asserted: historical provenance of this exact parameterization
identity of the triswale readout with helix pitch

family.c3_map: element i -> i+1 mod 3 by R_xy(2*pi/3)

primitive_geometry.center_policy: held fixed across plus/midpoint/minus controls so Three-Spheres center-only output is an invariance control

director_contract.representation: oriented orthonormal 2-plane U_i=(u_i,v_i), with any full SO(4) completion explicitly downstream gauge/convention
director_contract.u_i: unit radial vector in the xy control plane from the equilateral-triangle circumcenter to center i
director_contract.orthogonality_note: u_i lies in xy while v_i lies in zw, hence u_i dot v_i = 0 identically
director_contract.orientation_note: ordered pair (u_i,v_i) is primitive; do not silently identify an arbitrary SO(4) completion with primitive geometry

three_spheres: project centers to xy control plane
verify carrier payload invariant across all three control values
hagalaz: choose and record one deterministic full-frame completion rule from each oriented director pair
serialize all six antisymmetric omega_ab channels
compute ordered transport Q_gamma around the declared lambda loop
report SO(4) conjugacy invariants such as the two principal rotation angles
symmetry_controls: verify plus/minus mirror relation under declared e_w reflection
verify C3-related element channels obey the derived conjugation relation rather than an imposed equality
change only the arbitrary frame-completion gauge and distinguish raw-component changes from declared gauge-invariant transport observables
midpoint_classification: classify helix/chiral readout independently if supplied by a separate derived map
test whether closed ordered transport is identity
do not infer one result from another

important_limitation: This control activates a closed lambda-dependent director excursion through the zw plane while preserving the equilateral center geometry. It is suitable for testing the endpoint-frame-versus-history interface distinction. It does not yet establish that this director law is the unique or intended geometric realization of the triswale/Graticule construction.
next_cursor: Meridian: consume this manifest as a declared control, choose an explicit deterministic SO(4) frame-completion gauge, derive the six omega_ab(lambda) channels and ordered Q_gamma for plus/midpoint/minus, and classify whether the interface preserves static endpoint relations separately from path-dependent transport.
